name: @dsh-external/dsh-planner
description: Planner master-scheduling agent plugin for CTF: receives challenge input via the cordis event bus, decomposes it into a CoT-style DAG of subtasks, schedules execution with timeouts/retries/failure handling, and persists every task, intermediate result, failure and candidate flag through the blackboard service (ctx.blackboard). Supports checkpoint resume after harness restarts.
